name.ja: HG 1/144 ダナジン（紫カラー）

description.ja: 『機動戦士ガンダムＡＧＥ』から、ガンプラＨＧ 限定Ｖｅｒ．登場！
description.en: From "Mobile Suit Gundam AGE", GunplaHG limited version. Appearing!

description.ja: 異彩を放つフォルムとカラーが人気のダナジン（紫カラー）、キット化！
description.en: Danagin (purple color), which is popular for its distinctive form and color, is now available as a kit!

description.ja: 『機動戦士ガンダムＡＧＥ』に登場のダナジン（紫カラー）をＨＧで商品化。
description.en: Danagin (purple color) that appears in "Mobile Suit Gundam AGE" is commercialized in HG.

description.ja: ●印象的な紫を成形色で徹底再現。
description.en: - Thoroughly reproduce the impressive purple color with molding color.

description.ja: ●頭部のパーツの差し替えで飛行形態を再現可能。
description.en: - Flight form can be reproduced by replacing head parts.

description.ja: ●平手の他、掌にビームバルカンを再現した表情付きの手が付属。
description.en: -In addition to the open hand, a hand with an expression that reproduces Beam Vulcan is included on the palm.

description.ja: ●首、腰、翼にボールジョイントを採用し、恐竜のような躍動感あるポージングが可能。
description.en: -Ball joints are used for the neck, waist, and wings, allowing for dynamic dinosaur-like poses.

description.ja: １／１４４スケール組み立て式プラモデル
description.en: 1/144 Scale Assembly plastic model

description.ja: 対象年齢：８才以上
